Prepare Debian for Raspberry Pi boot.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name            | Default  | Description                                                                         |
| --------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `with_firmware` | `"true"` | Install non-free firmware packages when with_nonfree is enabled. Use true or false. |
| `with_nonfree`  | `"true"` | Enable non-free and non-free-firmware archive components. Use true or false.        |
| `with_squashfs` | `"true"` | Include SquashFS support in the initramfs. Use true or false.                       |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `100000`     |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Adds Raspberry Pi's package repository, installs its kernel and boot tooling,
and copies the resulting firmware into the boot tree. The recipe's boot
configuration must match the image assembly used by the system.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-debian-setup"]
```
